summary: Beamr Imaging filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 30, 2026, announcing a three-year renewal of its license agreement with a major global streaming platform, extending through October 2029. The company guided fiscal year 2026 revenues to approximately $4.5 million, up about $1.5 million or roughly 50% year over year, citing existing agreements, renewals and broader business activities. No M&A, tender, activist, spin-off, restructuring or delisting event is involved; this is a routine foreign private issuer current report on commercial and guidance developments. Watch execution on the renewal and guidance credibility, not deal terms.
